meta.purpose: Single planning-input set for the five-market equity allocation optimizer. Assumptions, not forecasts.
meta.return_convention: Gross arithmetic returns are optimizer inputs. Approximate gross geometric return = gross arithmetic return - 0.5 * volatility^2. Net geometric return = gross geometric return - fee - dividend withholding drag. Net arithmetic MVO return = gross arithmetic return - fee - dividend withholding drag.
meta.fee_tax_convention: One fee and withholding estimate per market. Dividend withholding drag = dividend yield * withholding rate.
sources: The current user-selected planning assumptions in chinese-couch-potato-technical-note.md
